audio: None; captions are added to the recorded browser view

scenes.title: A fictional credit operations desk
scenes.caption: All records are synthetic. This walkthrough uses a public, read-only account.

scenes.title: Choose a demo perspective
scenes.caption: The credit analyst view opens the review queue. Demo roles do not verify real identities.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: Start with synthetic exposure, pending reviews and the work that needs attention.

scenes.title: Client relationships
scenes.caption: Open a fictional borrower and follow the evidence behind its facility position.

scenes.title: Client 360
scenes.caption: Facility headroom, debtor exposure and dated ledger balances are shown together. Headroom is not drawable funding.

scenes.title: Evidence and activity
scenes.caption: The timeline links recorded synthetic events and preserves their business dates.

scenes.title: Collections
scenes.caption: Inspect dated arrears and payment evidence. Historical comparisons respect when invoices became known.

scenes.title: Borrowing-base scenario
scenes.caption: Reconcile the same client's ledger to exclusions and haircuts. These illustrative policy inputs do not authorize lending.

scenes.title: Invoice Check
scenes.caption: Rules detect issues; cited explanations support review. Stored synthetic decisions remain separate from funding authority.

scenes.title: Portfolio Watch
scenes.caption: Review synthetic detections and their evidence. Counts describe recorded events, not a risk forecast.

scenes.title: Credit assessment draft
scenes.caption: The memo lists evidence and missing facts. Its Markdown export is unsigned and requires analyst review.

scenes.title: Trust Panel
scenes.caption: Compare decisions with agent recommendations while keeping simulated history and exposed reviews distinct.

scenes.title: Frozen decision replay
scenes.caption: Reopen a stored synthetic decision and verify its checksum. The snapshot preserves what was recorded at decision time.
